character.description: An ordinary man in his mid-30s, medium build, short dark brown hair, three-day stubble, plain unremarkable face. Looks like a real person, not a model. Dirt on his hands and forearms, sweat on his brow.
character.wardrobe: Olive-drab work jacket with a torn left cuff, grey thermal shirt underneath, dark brown canvas trousers with mud at the knees, scuffed brown leather boots. Same clothes in every single shot, progressively dirtier.
distinguishingFeatures: torn left cuff on the jacket
grey thermal collar always visible at the neck
mud line on trousers at the knee
no hat, no sunglasses, no modern branding

environment.description: A dense temperate forest clearing on a gentle slope. Bare deciduous trees, leaf litter, exposed roots, moss on fallen logs. Damp brown earth. No buildings, roads, or machinery anywhere in frame.
environment.timeOfDay: flat overcast daylight, no direct sun
environment.weather: cold, damp, occasional light drizzle, breath faintly visible

lighting: Flat natural overcast light. Soft shadows, no golden hour, no dramatic rim light, no lens flare. The light of an ordinary grey afternoon in a forest.
cameraStyle: Handheld POV-adjacent bushcraft documentary. Camera sits low and close, often at arm's length. Small natural shake. No drone, no crane, no sweeping aerials, no slow-motion.
lensStyle: 24mm to 35mm, close to the work. Hands and tools fill the frame. Shallow depth only on macro detail shots.

props.name: shovel
props.description: Worn steel spade, chipped paint on the blade, weathered wooden shaft, dirt caked in the socket

props.name: axe
props.description: Small forest axe, scratched head, plain hickory handle

props.name: logs
props.description: Rough debarked pine logs, hand-cut ends showing saw and axe marks, not milled timber

props.name: bucket
props.description: Dented galvanised metal bucket for hauling soil

negativePrompt: cinematic color grading, golden hour, lens flare, drone shot, aerial view, slow motion, time-lapse, modern machinery, excavator, power tools, architectural glass, designer interior, polished, glossy, oversaturated, film trailer look, text overlay, watermark, multiple people
genreNote: Reference: bushcraft/survival dugout channels. The appeal is watching one person actually do the work with hand tools. Shots are close, patient, and unglamorous. Progress is shown by CUTTING between stages, never by compressing time inside a single shot.
